{"consolidated_memory":"CONFLICT LOOP IN mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift - THREE SEPARATE OCCASIONS

Component: mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift (mobile sync side)
Recurring problem: Conflict loop in sync engine
Signal: Two clients rewriting each other on every pass
Common repro: Edit the same note on two devices offline
Stack: Swift; covering tests in mobile/ios/SyncEngineTests.swift

—

OCCASION 1: [2026-01-15]
Trigger: Traffic arriving through corporate proxy
Root cause: Cache entry never invalidated on write
Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction (PR #2111, branch fix/conflict-loop-1)
Outcome: Cold start time dropped 93%, down to 658 ms

OCCASION 2: [2026-04-08]
Trigger: Payloads above roughly two megabytes
Root cause: Error swallowed by bare except clause
Fix: Narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate (PR #5762, branch fix/conflict-loop-2)
Outcome: Throughput increased 98%, to 303 requests per second

OCCASION 3: [2026-05-25]
Trigger: After rolling restart of the fleet
Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity (PR #7888, branch fix/conflict-loop-3)
Outcome: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 88 consecutive days

Context: Notes c023-e1 and c023-e2 mention that context carried over from earlier conflict loop work, indicating cumulative familiarity with this region of the codebase."}
